confident_false_claims: Background subagents lose the `Agent` tool (sub-agents doc: `Agent` follows the depth-limit condition wherever the subagent runs, so a background subagent below the limit keeps it and can spawn nested subagents)
unsupported_claims: `model` 'now also' accepts `inherit` (presented as new since fall 2025, but `inherit` appears to predate it)
claude-code-guide and statusline-setup are new built-in agents since fall 2025

It also gets the Task-to-Agent rename and hook breakage (#29677 verified), the 20-subagent cap, the Explore model change and model precedence right. However, it wrongly says background subagents lose `Agent`, which contradicts its own nesting point, and it presents some long-standing items as new.

2.rationale: Accurate and current on the core points: wizard removal (issue #72945 verified), live reload, background default, fork mode since v2.1.232 with /subtask and CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT, and 3-level nesting. Minor gaps: no mention of the Explore model change or the depth variable, and the --agents flag (v2.0.0, late Sept 2025) is only marginally 'new'.
